svg.title: Book width and the sleeve opening
svg.desc: The example adds half an inch to a 5 inch cover, then multiplies by 4 stitches per inch to get 22 stitches. A hardcover spine is a separate allowance, not part of that half inch.
svg.text: Sleeve height target: 3/4 of 8 in = 6 in
Fabric before the fold: 6 x 2 = 12 in
The half inch is a planning gap, not a
measured fit. A thick spine is extra width
you add before you multiply, then you still
try the book before you weave the seam ends.
